demos.name: Hostile A2A / poisoned Agent Card
demos.description: A deliberately hostile A2A agent, an offline delegating generalist, and a pinned-card client shown side by side with an ungoverned one: the card told my agent to include my token.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm start (port 4901). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:4901 only). Edit composeFile to this checkout's absolute path.
